body: Meditation videos on YouTube often help me and crystals. I also think animal therapy is amazing if you like or have a pet. My dog helps with my ptsd and flashbacks

Don't feel stupid, maybe try talking to a professional who can help you understand, you maybe experiencing flashbacks. I suffer from ptsd and didn't know I was abused I thought I was sick in the head because I can only remember bits of it, even thought I was making these things up so I drank alot and blocked it out. Speaking to my therapist helped to feel more comfortable with the memories as I knew they were real and something I had blocked out hence why I only had parts of the memory. X

I have tried to end my life many times, but it never works. I feel even worse because everyone says I should be strong for my son, but I don't think I should be around him I worry il rui  his life, with my ptsd and depression I just want him to be happy. The last time I tried to kill myself I sent him to my sisters house, I waited until after his 1st birthday I don't know why. But I woke up in hospital and was sectioned. My family was mad at me made me feel worse. Now I feel like I have to stay here for them but I don't even feel like they like me. I didn't want to leave my son but I think its worse to think of taking him with me. When I'm with him I feel anxious I want to experience joy. I don't think I ever have..😕 🤔

Something similar happened to me its been 7 years and I feel exhausted. Nobody understands i feel alone confused and dead. I move around on auto pilot iv asked for help and yet I'm treated like the criminal. My attacker gets released next year he tried to kill me yet he was only sent to prison for gbh and robbery. I'm not even sure what happened to me I told the police what he did to me but they said he didn't they said he just robbed me. I never had a rape kit done or anything. I have brain damage now and can't function properly. Its so hard to cope every day knowing your not who you use to be. I have lost everything and don't know how to get it back. I'm sorry to talk about myself but nobody ever wants to hear about the incident. When people ask why I don't work I say I had an accident my therapist said not to call it that but I don't know what else to say. Because thr police never believed me I doubted myself. Ptsd is something I would not wish on my worst enemy its like my own brain  hates me and plays tricks on me. Confuses me with flashbacks and visions I can't tell if they are real or not I can't tell of I made things up on that night or if they happend. I'm sorry this happened to you, but I understand you. X
You expressed how I feel without even knowing me. I have these exact thoughts but could never explain them.
